# UmiLife's Blog

My personal Hugo blog using the [Reimu theme](https://github.com/D-Sketon/hugo-theme-reimu).
Visit my blog at [umi4.life](https://umi4.life)

## Start Hugo's development server

```bash
hugo server --buildDrafts
```

## Git activity data

The heatmap on `/about/` reads [`static/data/activity.json`](static/data/activity.json).

**Do not edit this file manually.** It is vendored automatically when [`Umi4Life/git-activity`](https://github.com/Umi4Life/git-activity) receives updated `data/activity.json`.

### Refresh locally

```bash
# Linux / macOS
./scripts/vendor-activity.sh

# Windows PowerShell
./scripts/vendor-activity.ps1
```

## Add content

```bash
hugo new content content/posts/post-name/index.md
```
